Due to Tom Holland’s infamous reputation for accidentally spoiling major plot details in past interviews, the directors (The Russo Brothers) used extreme secrecy tactics during production. When it came time to shoot Tony Stark's funeral scene, the crew officially told Tom Holland that they were filming a wedding scene to protect the massive spoiler. The script and call sheets even used "The Wedding" as a fake codename.

The Realization
Holland arrived on set dressed up and expecting a joyous celebration. However, he quickly noticed that nearly 30 major MCU stars were gathered together—all dressed entirely in somber, black mourning attire.Confused by the dark clothing and setup, he famously turned to co-star Mark Ruffalo and asked, "Where's Robert? Why isn't the groom at his own wedding?" Only then did he find out the truth that they were actually shooting the tragic farewell to Iron Man.
